item.title: Re: A SCP idea I have
item.content:encoded: Thank you! it is actually slightly based on SCP-650 (which is a statue) and the second method is almost always used when the first doesn't work. Sorry for being too vague, ill edit it.

item.title: Re: A SCP idea I have
item.content:encoded: The complaints of something watching the workers achieve that feeling of dread (for me, at least). I feel that the second method of killing diminishes that feeling—but then again, that's just me. All in all, I like it, though I seem to recall a mannequin that scares people via appearing behind them in aggressive poses.

item.title: A SCP idea I have
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror

Page Layout (Optional): The standard SCP article format.

Elevator Pitch: The basic idea is a jointed 2 metre tall dummy made of hardwood. When someone views it, the person will begin to have visual hallucinations centered around the dummy, This usually drives the viewer to the point of insanity which almost always results in suicide. This is one of 2 methods of killing its victim. The alternative and less likely way of killing is directly attacking its victim, only moving when they are not looking. This method is only used when the first does not work.

Central Narrative: The entity was found inside of an abandoned factory with unknown origins, after many people complaining about seeing a "wooden thing" watching them from inside the factory. Paranormal investigators found this interesting and went inside, more than half of them were found dead in their own homes. Foundation researchers went on the case and successfully captures it, with the cost of more than half of the researchers found dead in their offices.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The article will be short and simple, it won't have too much information about the entity leaving a mystery, I am also hoping to add a feeling of dread.

Additional Notes: None.
